_doc: TERMS-CROSSWALK-1 (owner directive 2026-11-12): words people and agents use for overlapping ideas, each mapped to one canonical glossary term. Checked by `python3 -m foundation crosswalk --check`; consumed by tests/foundation/test_crosswalk.py.
marker_text: TERMS-CROSSWALK: autonomous, automatic and unattended name one property (glossary `unattended`, `autonomy`): the loop runs on a clock or event on server-side infrastructure, closes itself and does not stop at an error. Say autonomous for a system, closed loop for one loop, unattended for the measure (merged work with no session driving it). Do not use never-terminating, non-terminating, hands-off or set-and-forget. Map and avoided words: doctrine/crosswalk.json (`python3 -m foundation crosswalk --check`).

entries.means: self-referential loops plus the ability to close them
a loop whose trigger, action, verification and write-back the system itself runs
entries.not: a loop a person must close

entries.means: owner's word for the same property as unattended: runs on a clock or event with no person in the path
entries.not: a step that needs an open session

entries.means: the agents' word and the measure: merged pull requests whose origin is the server-side executor
entries.not: a system a person cannot inspect

entries.means: does not stop at an error: a failure is recorded and the next run is a different attempt
entries.not: an unbounded process with no stop condition
